_note: Any other expenditure, not capital, laid out wholly and exclusively for making or earning the income is deducted (D-194; rulebook OS-GENERAL-001) — but never personal expenses, nor interest or salary payable outside India untaxed (OS-NODED-001: a nil line), nor anything against dividends or unit income (OS-DIVIDEND-INTEREST) or interest on compensation (OS-COMPENSATION-INTEREST).
